docs.title: Summary
docs.text: I am an experienced software engineer with a strong focus on Java development. I have worked on building and maintaining cloud systems, microservices, and data processes for various industries. Skilled in modern tools like AWS, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines, I create reliable and efficient solutions. My work combines technical expertise with a practical approach to deliver high-quality results.
